name: George Haughton Realtor- Bellator Real Estate
description: Living in Orange Beach for most of my life has been a blessing. I can not think of a better place to call home! In the early 1900's my family built a vacation cottage here called 'Bruin Cottage' (named for the local Brown Bear). My family then made the trip here to enjoy the summer months for generations after. That understanding of what this place has to offer is what inspires me today. From childhood, I remember dirt roads, no air conditioning & no telephone... In those days we saw more armadillos than people! All we cared about was the sun, the water and nothing else. Some things don't change! These simple pleasures are what turned Orange Beach and Gulf Shores into one of the most sought after vacation destinations in the country! Now with so much more to do! Before my time in Real Estate and as a REALTOR, I was in the boat business and aerial advertising business. I am motivated in assisting people in finding their own piece of Paradise on our beautiful Island and surrounding areas. Just a phone away and I will work hard to earn your trust! I look forward to hearing from you.
